book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ, Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowo u nɑ u wɑɑsu mɔ̀ Yudeɑn ɡbɑburɔ.
U nɛɛ, i bɛɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsio domi Gusunɔ u sisi u bɑndu swĩi.
Yohɑnu wiyɑ wìn ɡɑri Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Esɑi u mɔ̀ sɑnɑm mɛ u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Goo u ɡerumɔ kɑ dɑm ɡbɑburɔ u mɔ̀,
kpɑ i n ye nɔɔ nɛrɑsiɑmɔ yu dɛndɑ.”

content: Yohɑnu wi, u yooyoon sɑnsun yɑberu sebuɑ, mɑ u ɡɔnɑn kpɑkɑ sɛ̃ke pɔrɑɔ. Win dĩɑnɑ twee kɑ tim bɑusu.
Tɔmbɑ nɑ win mi sɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di kɑ Yudeɑn tem kpuro, kɑ tem kpuron di mɛ mu dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛni sikerenɛ.
Bɑ ben torɑnu tuubɑ kuɑ mɑ u bu bɑtɛmu kuɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛniɔ.
Ye Yohɑnu u wɑ mɑ Fɑlisibɑ kɑ Sɑdusibɑ dɑbinu bɑ nɑ win mi u kɑ bu bɑtɛmu ko, u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ wɑɑ ɡɔsɔnu wɑrɑ u mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ i Gusunɔn mɔru dukɑ suuri ye yɑ wee.
I de bɛɛn kookoosu su sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ i ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ.
I kun tɑmɑɑ i ko ɡɑfɑrɑ wɑ Aburɑhɑmun sɔ̃ domi i ɡerumɔ i mɔ̀ u sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑ. Nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ Gusunɔ u koo kpĩ u kpee ni suɑ u kɑ Aburɑhɑmu bibu kuɑ.
Wee, bɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ wɑsi kɔ bu kɑ dɑ̃ɑ wukiri. Dɑ̃ru bɑɑtere te tɑ ǹ bii ɡeenu mɑrumɔ terɑ bɑ koo burɑ kpɑ bu doke dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Nɛ nɑ bɛɛ bɑtɛmu mɔ̀ kɑ nim i kɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑbun seedɑ di, ɑdɑmɑ wi u sisi nɛn biruɔ u koo bɛɛ bɑtɛmu ko kɑ Hunde Dɛɛro kɑ dɔ̃ɔ. U mɑn dɑm kere ɡem ɡem, sere nɑ ǹ mɑm turɑ n kɑ win bɑrɑnu suɑ n nɛnɛ.
U win sɑrɑtiɑ nɛni win nɔmɑɔ, u koo win ɑlikɑmɑ soo yeru kurɑ kpɑ u win ɑlikɑmɑ ɡurɑ u doke birɑru sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ u koo sɑkosu doke dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Yesu u nɑ sɑɑ Gɑlilen di u dɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛniɔ, Yohɑnu u kɑ nùn bɑtɛmu ko.
Adɑmɑ Yohɑnu u kĩ u yinɑ. U nɛɛ, wunɑ n weenɛ ɑ mɑn bɑtɛmu ko, yerɑ ɑ mɑɑ nɑ nɛn mi?
Adɑmɑ Yesu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ de n koorɑ mɛ ɡinɑ, domi nɡe mɛyɑ sɑ ko kɑ kpuro ko ye Gusunɔ u bikiɑmɔ. Mɑ Yohɑnu u wurɑ.
Ye u Yesu bɑtɛmu kuɑ u kpɑ, mii mii Yesu u yɑrɑ nim sɔɔn di. Yerɑ wɔllɑ wukiɑrɑ, mɑ u Gusunɔn Hunde wɑ u sɑrɑm wee nɡe kpɑruko, u nɑ u sinɑ win wiru wɔllɔ.
Mɑ nɔɔ ɡɑɡu ɡɑ nɔɔrɑ wɔllun di ɡɑ nɛɛ, winiwɑ nɛn Bii kĩnɑsi wì sɔɔ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru dobu kpuro wɑ̃ɑ.
